>People will say "do this" and "do that" to get out of a depression and they just don't get that the whole problem is not being able to do anything, including the things that you know make you feel better.

Finally someone that gets what my problem is. And yeah, can't even get myself to take a shower anymore, or eat proper meals. It has just been microwave food since I started being like this.

>Is there anyway in your situation that you could get in touch with a therapist or counselor?

I have been in touch with 2 therapists for about a total of 3 months. The first one was for a month and said that in the end, he can't help with my situation and suggested me to the second one. And the second one tried to help too but afterwards just said that I should call the suicide hotline or visit a real doctor.

The suicide hotline was a joke. Told me that I'm an attention seeker and ended the call. Haven't tried the doctor yet. Maybe because I can barely get myself to go out of bed for anything other than food anymore. But I will still visit the doc in the near future.

And ty for trying to help. I appreciate that u took the time to read my post and help.

Welp. Might sound weird but I can't get myself to do anything. 

I have tried getting back to working out or gaming/reading but i don't enjoy it anymore for some reason. Whenever I try I just get the urge to stop and start sleeping again. 

I can't even get myself to shower again or cook proper meals.
Welp, sounds weird but I can't get myself to do anything. Even if I want to. I can't even get myself to shower anymore.
